method: Read source and relevant tests at immutable PR243 Git tree; independently pin reviewed Git blob identities to the full untruncated tree; analyze externally reachable brokerage/trading mutations, read-only provider network paths and credential handling, installer/ZIP/selection/update/rollback/uninstall and owner-state custody, diagnostic presentation. This is bounded static review backed by passing original test suites, not a comprehensive penetration test or live account experiment.

findings.evidence: liveBrokerageAuthorized() returns false without environment override; PlaceOrder, GetOrder, CancelOrder refuse before transport. Private Place requires journal, immutable intent and precision evidence; historical HTTP 423 and browser PAPER submission disabled; Create/Cancel acknowledgments never proof of fills. No connected LIVE or broker writes performed.

Fixed HTTPS api.coinbase.com GET only, bounded account and pagination scope, non-forwarding/no-proxy system TLS client, no redirects, bounded response and strict JSON; requires ephemeral OAuth token or separately supplied local disarmed CDP credentials. These paths do not independently prove account mapping, source authenticity, history completeness, or release authority; no real provider call made in review.

Tracked config.json broker key, secret, account and tunnel fields empty; complete untruncated tree contains no tracked .env, PEM, P12/PFX or obvious credential-file paths. Legacy config loader uses local regular-file .env, rejects shell interpolation and requires LIVE_TRADING=false, replaces JSON legacy secrets. Native diagnostics module adds only disclosure controls, no RPC/storage/network. Does not prove all log or OS-memory paths free of identifiers.

ZIP path normalization, Windows device/collision/refusal, bounded expanded bytes/file count, quarantine and proof before atomic candidate publication; source-pinned unsigned self-contained installer, no automatic release/signing. Setup UI executes bounded operation in separate worker and surfaces worker diagnostics to local UI; no connected production install executed.

Exclusive selector and transition lock, durable stop/quarantine marker, immutable hash-checked selection and cold escrow, restore only Pine library and strategies, no browser/PAPER/credentials into successor; uninstall checks exact prior file hashes, removes only enumerated code/empty dirs and preserves unknown data. Existing negative tests cover unsafe ZIP, interrupted updates and modified/occupied targets.
The original donor kill state is not proven durable over restart. Paper coordinator's separate cold stop barrier is qualified; it does not authorize original TradeGuard LIVE re-arm. No LIVE testing.
Synthetic-only reconciliation receipt and verification explicitly do not authorize actual owner-profile migration, rollback, or release.

qualifications.reuse_condition: Only unchanged immutable source/tree, tests, toolchain, workflow and provenance; no mandatory regression skipped.

next_gate: Complete a separate bounded review of remaining high-risk original runtime HTTP/RPC, financial accounting and process-custody boundaries; only advance integration if acceptance requirements are met. Do not repeat exact-identical qualification merely for static source review.
